About roll labels

Labels that look as good as your product.

Roll labels are printed on an HP Indigo digital press, so even short runs get crisp detail and rich colour. Choose white BOPP for waterproof everyday labels, clear for a no-label look, metallic for shine or freezer-grade adhesive for cold storage.

Tell us how your labels come off the roll (unwind direction) and how many you want on each roll; we match it for your applicator or for hand application.

Waterproof stocks

BOPP and poly resist water, oil and fridge condensation.

Any shape

Standard shapes or a custom die line from your artwork.

Ready to apply

3 in cores, your choice of unwind direction and labels per roll.

Fast turnaround

Standard or rush production after proof approval.

Questions

Labels & stickers FAQ

What is the difference between roll labels, sticker sheets and die-cut stickers?

Roll labels come on a 3 in core for fast hand or machine application on products and packaging. Sticker sheets hold several kiss-cut stickers on one sheet for handouts and short runs. Die-cut stickers are cut one by one around the outline of your design.

Which material should I choose?

White BOPP is waterproof and the best all-rounder for products, jars and bottles. Clear BOPP gives a no-label look, silver/metallic adds shine, and freezer-grade adhesive holds in the cold. Paper is the economical choice for dry packaging.

Can I order a custom shape?

Yes. Choose “Custom die-cut shape” and upload artwork with a cut line, or send the logo and we will create the die line and include it in your proof.

How do you calculate the price?

The price depends on the label size (area), the quantity, the material and the finish. Larger quantities lower the price per label. The amount you see is the price before tax; it is confirmed in your proof.

Do I get a proof?

Always. We send a digital proof showing size, shape and cut line. Nothing is printed until you approve it.
